scope: Canonical Ollama launcher, setup and normal stack startup; synthetic shell/process contracts plus existing operations-health routes.

historical_launcher_setup_stage.relationship: Overlapping earlier stage. Do not add its pass count to this final selection.

intermediate_run_orb_stage.relationship: Overlapping subset of final 110; not additive.

meaningful_boundaries: Exact tested version/hardware eligibility and actual executable version precedence.
Explicit settings preserved or conflicts rejected; loopback only before version/probe requests.
Canonical setup endpoint; private log creation; ownership check rejects a different listener.
Normal startup matches backend loopback URL, including explicit port80 for no-port HTTP URLs.
Optional AI failure or unavailable executable does not block backend boot.
Owned daemon tracked separately, bounded cleanup and wait only for app PIDs; reused daemon untouched.
INT/TERM during optional startup exits130/143 with one cleanup and no later backend launch.
limits: Launcher and startup tests use synthetic executables/processes; no actual model inference, downloads, shared daemon, live environment or private data touched.
Actual full-SWA latency/memory pilot is separately recorded in docs/audit-2026-10/sage-swa-cache-control-20261012.json.
Off does not override independently enabled llama.cpp config.ini settings.
NO_CLOUD is not an operating-system egress firewall.
No claim of complete application/clinical acceptance from this focused selection; full v8 and browser acceptance are separate.
